title: Both 3.1.0.1 full-release and its dev version have a bluetooth permission error
symptom: After updating to 3.1.0.1, a bluetooth permission error occurs in both full-release and dev versions. The user could not find a setting to enable bluetooth for AAPS and rolled back to 3.1.0-dev.
cause: The issue was triggered by the 3.1.0.1 code, affecting Android versions 9, 10, and 11, but not Android 12. The maintainer could replicate on an older phone.
fix: The maintainer fixed the issue in master.
